head: 254cbe052b9cfac3a65283b7cd004fc9d9c1d79d
scope: Read-only first r3 support bookkeeping review. No builds/tests/native runs/production edits; only advisory file written. GPU restoration, B Store and measurement correction not implemented by this increment.
disposition: No concrete blocking correctness or lifetime regression identified in this bounded source delta. No performance, full r3 completion or owner ratification claim.
analysis: Pixels capture uses actual emitted board/schematic interaction triangles and the same integer scissor conversion used at draw sites. Outward floor/ceil plus one-pixel guard is conservative; extent clamping, checked scissor sums, nonfinite rejection and malformed triangle rejection fail closed.

Rectangles are exclusive-right/bottom, stored in32 inline slots, deduplicated exactly, empty clipped bounds skipped. Overlap is preserved for union; overflow rejects reuse. Two triangles of an axis-aligned quad share bounds, preserving thin crosshair arms rather than a full-pane box.

Presented Completed retains key/pair/support/revision. New begin replaces requested support but not presented support. Revision equality with matching strong/preparation/target/pair yields empty damage for exposure; changed revision unions old completed support with newest requested support. Unknown old/new support and overflow reject reuse.

finish_snapshot checks active receipt and actual target; current strong/preparation key rejects content/composition changes. A pointer update during an active frame may legitimately complete older displayed support; next frame unions against that actual completion. Failed attempts clear valid state. Dropped/superseded receipts force strong target revision on next begin, preventing abandoned encoded images from reuse.
Capture cannot acknowledge native damage; its completion changes strong target revision through existing receipt protocol, making captured validity unusable for subsequent native target reuse.

Prefix size has compile-time <=4096 assertion and all support records are inline. No new heap lists/cache/history or GPU resources introduced. Actual total process/resource accounting and queued-uniform ownership remain later GPU integration obligations.
Existing full-copy graph still overwrites B before suffix and discards B afterward. New damage metadata is not yet used to restore samples and cannot establish retained-B correctness.

Source tests cover coalescing, failure, pair/strong invalidation, exposure, unknown bounds, union overflow and real thin crosshair motion/leave; they are not GPU raster coverage or all-pane exactness proof. Required future exact8x/scissor/union boundary and multi-pane controls remain.
advisories: When wiring GPU restoration, use rectangles as x,y,right-x,bottom-y scissors and the exact same integer union for suffix predicate; restore all samples and reset appropriate scissor/pipeline bindings before suffix.

Keep full fallback on unsupported/overflow support, rather than silently dropping strips. Current change makes prior A reuse conditional on support validity, conservatively adding cold work when support is unknown; do not claim unchanged full-copy performance.
